changelog.message: op created to control global macOS mouse cursor position, clicks, drags, and scrolling using a native background sidecar process
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Controls mouse movement, absolute positioning, clicks, drags, and scrolling globally on macOS using a native background sidecar process.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Starts or stops the native Swift MouseController sidecar process and its WebSocket listener.

ports.name: Emit
ports.text: Fires a trigger to synthesize and emit the virtual mouse actions globally.

ports.name: Mouse Object
ports.text: An object containing optional properties: 'x' (coordinate), 'y' (coordinate), 'button' ('left', 'right', 'middle'), 'action' ('click', 'down', 'up', 'move', 'drag'), 'scrollX' (horiz scroll), and 'scrollY' (vert scroll).

ports.name: Emitted Mouse
ports.text: An object echoing the last successfully emitted mouse state configuration.

ports.name: On Emitted
ports.text: Fires a trigger every time a virtual mouse event is successfully emitted globally.

ports.name: Running
ports.text: True if the native mouse control sidecar process is running.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: Human-readable status of the Swift sidecar process.
